metadata.source: Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services — Medicare Part D Prescribers by Provider and Drug
metadata.scope: Reported Medicare Part D sildenafil claims, grouped by prescriber practice city and specialty.
notes: City is the prescriber practice location reported in NPPES; it is not patient residence or pharmacy location.
Claims include original prescriptions and refills.
Provider-level rows below CMS suppression thresholds are not present in the source file.
